reason: A command move now carries the span its change happened within instead of one instant, so a removal dated only by its directory's later mtime is no longer read as written at that instant. One full UPDATE of command_window rewrites each journaled move's writtenAt as a written span of that same instant; the table holds only command windows not yet decided, which leave it within seconds. Measured during authoring on one development machine: command_window 3 rows (max rowid 3), no settled moves.
